  1. Work

cad-ai — AI-driven engineering drawings

A system that turns a plain-language request into a CAD file with verified dimensions, ready for production.

Client
Our in-house project
Industry
Engineering, artificial intelligence
Status
In active development
Year
2026

Challenge

An engineering drawing has to be exact: a good-looking drawing with a wrong dimension causes errors in production. Plain AI generation gives no such guarantee.

Solution

The AI draws only through 16 permitted tools; every action is bounded by write and save limits.

Two ways to control it — desktop AI apps over the MCP protocol or a local LLM (Ollama, LM Studio) — share one tool layer.

Dimensions are re-measured from the drawing itself and checked by a validator.

Result

Output is DXF, which AutoCAD reads fully; Windows is not required.

The core phases are complete and 167 automated tests pass.

Not just good-looking — correct.

Deterministic output

The same request gives the same verified drawing.

MCP server

Direct control from desktop AI apps.

Local LLM

Work with models on your own server, without data leaving it.

Dimension validator

Layers and dimensions are checked from the drawing itself.

Technology

PythonezdxfMCPOllamaLM StudioAutoCAD COM/.NET
